newsitem.title: UK: London gold sinks to fix at fresh 3-1/4 year low.
newsitem.headline: London gold sinks to fix at fresh 3-1/4 year low.

text.p: Gold prices were fixed at $359.25 an ounce on Monday morning, the lowest fixing since October 7, 1993, in the heavily bearish bullion market.
Its previous fixing on Friday was $364.00 an ounce.

Gold prices dropped sharply on Friday afternoon as New York-based investment funds increased their "short" positions, anticipating still lower prices. Investors have shunned gold in favour of strong stock markets in recent months.
"We've seen continued fund selling last week," a dealer said. "No one wants to touch it."
Prices continued edging steadily lower in Asia and Europe early on Monday, although some dealers expected some support to emerge at around $358.
The other precious metals were weaker with gold, and platinum was fixed at a fresh 3-1/4 year low of $362.75 an ounce on Monday morning.
